# Survey the engine runtime since 13.1 for the 13.2 notes

## Context

This is a survey leaf of #14800. It follows the [survey method](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/14800#issuecomment-5792321883) (@tobiu, 2026-09-23: the window is roughly 1,500 PRs and the split moved the Brain and the Fleet Manager out of scope).

This leaf covers the **runtime** slice: 102 merged PRs, listed in the first comment. It holds PRs scoped `worker`, `vdom`, `main`, `manager`, `core`, `data`, `state`, … and, for PRs whose title names no scope, those touching those `src/` paths.

## The Problem

The runtime is where multi-window behaviour, workers and the VDom live. A reader decides on an upgrade from exactly this, and the notes cover none of it yet. A chapter-4 deposit on #14800 ("two roots, one heap") covers one night of it. The rest of the slice is unread.

## The Architectural Reality

The population rule and the Tier 1–3 rubric are in the method comment. A PR that also touched split-out paths counts only for its engine-side change, and only when that change is reader-relevant.

## The Fix

Read all 102 PRs, and open their resolved tickets where the title can't answer the tier. Then fold the slice's reader-relevant items into `resources/content/release-notes/v13.2.0.md` as reader prose, inside the structure #19120 set. The survey itself (counts, exclusions, nominations) stays out of the public notes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 Every PR in the slice is read. The counts (read, listed, excluded, with reasons) are posted as a comment on this ticket, and the notes carry no counts line. *(Re-pointed 2026-09-24: the items ship in #19121, vehicle B, so no PR of this ticket carries a body.)*
- [ ] AC-2 Each Tier 1–3 item reaches the notes as reader prose, through #19120 → PR #19121: what a reader can now do or must now know, with its PR or ticket. The notes carry no survey ledger.
- [ ] AC-3 At most two chapter nominations, each with evidence and its mining state, posted on #14800 rather than in the notes.
- [ ] AC-4 Reviewed cross-family.

> **Updated 2026-09-23:** after the operator's register ruling on the merged notes (#19120), the counts and nominations move out of the public notes.

## Out of Scope

- Tier-2 items beyond noting them: the upgrade-path leaf owns them.
- Dock and grid, which have their own leaves.

## Related

#14800 · PR #19091 · the chapter-4 deposit on #14800 · D#18730
